title: Ultimate Muscle: Legends vs. New Generation

info.about: Ultimate Muscle: Legends vs. New Generation, known in Japan as Kinnikuman Nisei New Generation vs. Legends , is a wrestling video game based on the anime and manga, Ultimate Muscle. It was developed in Japan by AKI Corporation and released in Japan and North America only on the GameCube.
info.trivia: Its follow-up, Galactic Wrestling: Featuring Ultimate Muscle, skipped GameCube and came out only on PlayStation 2 in 2004.
info.why: The game was released only on GameCube, and its later expansions were sold as separate PS2 and PSP games, so this 2003 disc is the only edition there is.
